title: agora.local-room/v1
description: Conversation contracts of the explicit opt-in, loopback-only local-development room (local-room L1). One project room: command identity, human or explicitly local-agent authorship, immutable messages, an ordered per-room sequence, citations to persisted records, snapshots and receipts. Cursors and the base receipt reuse sync.schema.json; errors reuse errors.schema.json. Nothing here defines production identity, transport authority, search, uploads, task authority or a model provider, and nothing here authorizes a hosted operation.

LocalRoomScope.description: Project and room identity of one local room. Both are opaque UUIDs fixed by the local development service (L2), never chosen from a hosted workspace.

RoomAuthor.description: Who wrote a persisted message. The service derives it from the caller; a command never carries it. local_agent is the bounded local center response (L5), labelled explicitly and never a live model provider.

RecordCitation.description: Reference to a record already persisted in the same room. record_kind is closed; L1 knows only messages. room_seq repeats the cited message's sequence so a reader can locate it without a lookup; adapters check that the record exists at or below the citing message.

RoomMessageBody.description: Message text: 1 to 4096 Unicode scalars (at most 16 KiB UTF-8). Rendered as text, never as markup.

SendRoomMessageCommand.description: Body of POST /api/v1/local-room/messages. command_id is the client's idempotency key; the service derives the actor and computes request_digest over these canonical bytes (see CommandIdentity). citations is required so absent and empty never differ in the digest.

CommandIdentity.description: Idempotency identity of one command as R07 defines it: the same (actor, command_id) with the same request_digest replays the original receipt; a different digest is a conflict. The actor is not on the wire because the service derives it.

RoomMessage.description: One immutable persisted message. room_seq is the room stream's per-room counter allocated in the same transaction as the message; a snapshot lists messages in ascending room_seq. L1 defines no edit or tombstone: a correction is a new message. command_id names the command that created it.

RoomMessageCreatedEvent.description: R07 envelope for the one L1 event kind. stream_id is the room_id and seq equals the payload's room_seq. actor is the historical principal, not caller authority. An unknown kind is refused on the wire, so a client never acknowledges an event it cannot apply.

RoomSnapshot.description: Room state and cursor from one repeatable read. Subscription starts strictly after cursor.committed_seq; messages are ascending by room_seq and bounded so a reader never receives an unbounded history in one answer.

RoomEventBatch.description: Committed events strictly after the requested cursor, ascending, at most 50 per HTTP poll. Empty means caught up, not end of stream. No event compaction in this disposable local runtime.

LocalRuntimeReport.description: Local-only lifecycle CLI receipt. launch is a public UUID, never its secret challenge key. Optional data is the same public room contract as HTTP. Resource metadata is diagnostic, never PID-only cleanup authority.

RoomCommandReceipt.description: 201 answer of a committed send. receipt is the reusable R07 receipt (aggregate_id is the room, revision its room_seq after the append). replayed is true when identity matched an earlier command and the original receipt was returned without a second message.
